'''Zan Loren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] working for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] from [[3649 BBY]] to at least [[3643 BBY]]. In the [[Shadow Town]] on Nar Shaddaa, he asked a Republic hero to rescue prisoners from Imperial [[Camp 27]].
